sections.theory:
Exercise questions

1. Choose and write the suitable answers.

i. In badminton doubles the length of the court is ________ feet.

(a) 40  (b) 42  (c) 44  (d) 46

ii. The height of the badminton net in the middle is ________ feet.

(a) 3  (b) 5  (c) 7  (d) 9

iii. In the shuttle there are ________ feathers.

(a) 10  (b) 12  (c) 14  (d) 16

iv. The breadth of the badminton singles court is ________ feet.

(a) 15  (b) 17  (c) 20  (d) 23

v. The back gallery of the badminton court is ________ feet.

(a) 1′-6″  (b) 2′-6″  (c) 3′-6″  (d) 4′-6″

vi. The side gallery is ________ feet.

(a) 1′-6″  (b) 2′-6″  (c) 3′-6″  (d) 4′-6″

vii. The weight of the shuttle is at least ________ grams.

(a) 4.7  (b) 5.7  (c) 6.7  (d) 7.7
